manifest.name: v2-ridge-residual-demean
manifest.description: V1 baseline (kinematic single-track + understeer + first-order lag + per-segment delta0) plus a per-platform 11-feature ridge regression on V1's yaw-rate residual, with per-segment partial demeaning (alpha=0.7) of the correction to suppress integrated CTE drift.
notes: Tesla -> V0 passthrough (no truth available; cohort §0).
Coefficients fitted by closed-form ridge (lam=100) on train split (segments with hash >= 30).
Per-segment demean motivated by diagnose.py: full correction added segment-level yaw bias and degraded Mach-E CTE by +21% before demeaning.
